h1: The Face Hotel Yala — a small central-Yala stay with clean rooms, cold air-con, free parking and a light price
intro: The Face Hotel Yala is a small, 12-room property in a 5-storey building in the heart of Yala, on Soi Inthrachit. What guests talk about most is clean, spacious rooms, cold air-con, a quiet atmosphere and free parking at a very light price. It is easy to find, close to convenience stores and restaurants in town, with free Wi-Fi throughout and room service. This is a simple property that works best as a convenient base for business travellers, town sightseeing or an overnight stop before heading on to Betong. From approx. THB 700/night, score 7.7.

body.html: The Face Hotel Yala is a small property with just 12 rooms in a 5-storey building on Soi Inthrachit in Sateng, central Yala. It is positioned as a city stay that leans on cleanliness, quiet and convenience rather than resort-style facilities. With its small room count and central setting, it suits business travellers, people working in town, visitors exploring Yala city, and anyone wanting a clean, quiet room at an affordable price.

The thing voices from real guest reviews mention first is that the rooms are clean and roomier than expected, the air-con is cold, and the atmosphere is quiet. Many say they slept well thanks to the quiet rooms and genuinely cold air-con. Another common compliment is that it is easy to find and has free parking, a real plus if you drive yourself or rent a vehicle to explore the three southern provinces. Staff are praised for warm, attentive service. The overall feel is a plain but practical small city hotel that does the job and is good value.
"Easy to find, has parking, clean and spacious room, nice cold air-con, quiet, good service, and affordable — great for an overnight in town."

On the rooms, choices are kept simple: double rooms for couples or two guests, and twin rooms for friends or people working in town. Every room has air-conditioning, a refrigerator, a flat-screen TV, hot water and a shower, the basics covered, and all rooms are non-smoking. The room size is fine for an overnight, and reviews say they are clean and well kept. The thing to understand is that this is a small, simple hotel, with no grand lobby or large common areas; it focuses on a clean room at a light price.

On amenities, there is free parking, free Wi-Fi throughout, and room service, plus a staffed front desk. To be clear-eyed, this is a small property with no swimming pool, no large in-house restaurant, and breakfast that depends on the rate — some don't include it, so check at booking. But food is no worry: the central location is easy to find, with convenience stores, restaurants and cafes all within easy reach. There are also plenty of halal restaurants around Yala for travellers who eat halal.

Worth knowing before you book: this is a small hotel with only 12 rooms, so it fills up fast on long weekends and festivals — reserve ahead. It sits on a soi, easy to find but in a residential area rather than at the main sights, so having a car or rental makes exploring around town and onward to Betong easier. Small details like water pressure may vary room to room, as is normal for a small hotel. Overall it remains a practical, good-value stay at this level in central Yala.

In short, The Face Hotel Yala suits travellers who value clean, quiet rooms, a central location, a low price and parking over luxury or resort-style facilities. Its strengths are clear: clean rooms, cold air-con, a quiet atmosphere, an easy-to-find location and free parking, all at a wallet-friendly price. But if you want a pool, an in-house restaurant or a boutique feel, compare it against other hotels in town. For a Yala trip built around a clean, quiet sleep, business, town sightseeing or an overnight stop before driving on to Betong, this is a tidy, light-on-the-wallet base.

A tip from reading the reviews: book ahead, because there are only 12 rooms, especially on Thai long weekends when Yala and Betong are busy. If you drive, the free parking is genuinely handy, and plan your meals out, since restaurants and shops in town are an easy walk away. If you use it as a base to explore around the city and on to Betong, having your own car or a rental is the most flexible option.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — The Face Hotel Yala

faq.q: Where is The Face Hotel Yala, and what is nearby?
faq.a: It sits at 31/49 Soi Inthrachit 6, Sateng, Mueang Yala, in the city. It is a 5-storey building that is easy to find, with convenience stores and restaurants in town nearby. Old Yala Palace is about 1.6 km away, Yala Bus Terminal about 4.7 km and Yala Train Station about 5.5 km. Having a car or rental makes exploring around town and on to Betong easier.

faq.q: What is the starting price, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start around THB 700/night for a Double Room with one large bed and about THB 800 for a Twin Room with two single beds. Rates rise a little on holidays and festivals. There are only 12 rooms, so comparing a few platforms and booking ahead gets a better price.

faq.q: Does it have a swimming pool and breakfast?
faq.a: There is no swimming pool, and as a small hotel it has no large in-house restaurant. Breakfast depends on the rate you book — some don't include it, so check at booking. But the central location is easy to find, with convenience stores, restaurants and cafes, including halal eateries in town, all within easy reach.

faq.q: Who is The Face Hotel Yala best for?
faq.a: It suits business travellers, people working in town, visitors exploring Yala city and those stopping overnight before Betong who value clean, quiet rooms, a central location, a low price and parking. There is free parking and free Wi-Fi. If you want a pool, an in-house restaurant or a boutique feel, compare it with other options in town.

faq.q: Is there anything to know before staying?
faq.a: Know that this is a small hotel with only 12 rooms, so it fills up fast on long weekends — book ahead. It sits on a soi, easy to find but residential rather than at the main sights, so a car helps. There are few common areas and small details can vary from room to room, as is normal for a small hotel. Overall it is a clean, quiet, good-value stay at this level in central Yala.
